skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the importance of applying IT in management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the significance of using IT in management and the standards for commercial software applications.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Using C# programming language in Visual Studio
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Be able to use C# in Visual Studio for designing and programming modules of management software applications.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Designing user management and data security systems
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the importance and methods for implementing user management and data security systems in software applications.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Creating installation packages and user manuals
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Know how to compile installation packages and user manuals for software applications.
Have the ability to design databases, interfaces, and reports for management software applications.
Be capable of programming data interaction and generating reports for management software applications.
Be able to work independently or actively participate in group activities.
Be able to organize group activities, manage, and evaluate the quality of work of each member.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of management information systems.
